seo.title: ODDfest 2027 — Helsinki's creative week
seo.description: ODDfest is a city-wide week of independently made events across Helsinki. Hosts make the programme; ODD brings it together. Bring an event idea for 2027.

title: ODDfest 2027

heroMedia.sub: Bring something to Helsinki's creative week.

heroSupport: A week of independently made events across the city. You make yours — ODD builds the shared week around it.

whatItIs.headline: Made across Helsinki, by the people taking part.
whatItIs.body:
ODDfest is a week of independently made events across Helsinki. Artists, collectives, venues, organisations, communities and companies make and produce their own. Your event stays yours — your idea, your content, your name on it.

On its own, an event is one night in a city with a lot of nights in it. Put enough of them under one name, in one week, on one programme, and they become something a person can plan around.

ownership.headline: Your event. One shared week.

host.title: You, the host
host.body: You lead the idea, the content, the production and the economics. The event keeps your name and your decisions. Taking part asks you to hand over none of that.

odd.title: ODD
odd.body: We connect your event to the rest of the week: the ODDfest identity, one public programme, the communications, coordination between hosts, and introductions when there is a real match. What we will not do is decide your programme for you.

ownership.closing: ODD is not a production office, and ODDfest is not a logo placed on top of separate events. The point is to make independent work easier to find, and stronger for being found together.
ownership.stepsLabel: From an idea to the programme

howItWorks.title: Start with something you already want to make
howItWorks.body: An exhibition, a performance, a workshop, a screening, a dinner, an open studio, a club night, a conversation — or a format nobody has tried yet. If it belongs in Helsinki's creative life, it belongs in the week.

howItWorks.title: Tell us about it
howItWorks.body: It does not have to be finished, funded or scheduled. We want to know what you are making, roughly where and when it could happen, how far along it is, and whether there is anything you are still looking for.

howItWorks.title: Build it your way
howItWorks.body: You lead the production and keep control of the content, the budget and the practical decisions. Where there is a real fit, we can connect you with other hosts, venues, partners or resources. That help is case by case — ODD does not automatically fund or produce host events, and we would rather be plain about that now than let anyone plan around it.

howItWorks.title: Join the shared week
howItWorks.body: Your event is connected to the ODDfest identity, the public programme and the communications around the week. For a few days, independent work across Helsinki becomes easier to find as one whole.

join.headline: Bring something to ODDfest 2027.
join.body: We are collecting event ideas now, before the dates are fixed — which is the best moment to bring one. Tell us what you want to make happen, where you are with it, and what kind of connections or support would actually be useful.
join.reassurance: An idea still at the notes-on-your-phone stage is a fine thing to send. Sending it commits you to nothing, and we would far rather hear it early than hear it finished and too late.

history.headline: ODDfest has been made twice. 2027 is what those years taught us.
history.body:
ODDfest has been made twice, and both editions were produced from the middle, by us.

2025 proved the appetite was real. 2026 was bigger and centrally produced — loved by the people who came, and hard to explain to the people who did not. We carried the cost and the risk of nearly all of it, and that is the part we are not repeating. The part we produced least — a free week of events across the city, made by other people — is the part we are keeping.

chapters.title: The appetite turned out to be real
chapters.body: Two days at Lasipalatsikortteli under the theme Chaos & Acceleration. Eight stages, 83 sessions, 2,600+ participants, and speakers and artists from more than 20 nationalities. No previous edition to copy from, and about six months to do it in.

chapters.title: We built it bigger, and centrally
chapters.body: A festival across Helsinki venues under the theme Bravery, ODDference alongside it as its own professional event, and a free Creative Week across the city. Ambitious by design. Loved by the people who came, and hard to explain to the people who did not.

chapters.title: The week belongs to its hosts
chapters.body: What we produced centrally, we are not producing centrally again. ODDfest becomes the open week: hosts make and own their own events, and ODD builds the identity, the shared programme and the communications around them — so nobody is carrying a whole city on their own.

history.closing: So 2027 is not a restart. It is the version two years of making this taught us to build — and it only exists if people bring things to it.

examplesIntro.headline: One week, many different hosts.
examplesIntro.body: Real examples from Creative Week 2026 — different hosts, formats and places across the city.
examplesIntro.closing: The point is not that these events look alike. It is that, for one week, they become easier to discover together.

faq.question: Do I need to be an established organisation to host something?
faq.answer: No. Artists, collectives, venues, companies, communities and people with no organisation behind them at all are all welcome to host. There is no track record you need to have and no size you need to be.

faq.question: Is my event too small or too niche?
faq.answer: There is no minimum. A week made only of large events would miss the point of it. A one-room exhibition, a listening session for twenty people, or a workshop in your own studio are all the right size.

faq.question: Does taking part cost anything?
faq.answer: The 2027 participation model is still being finalised. Before any host is asked to commit, we will publish clearly what is charged, if anything, what is included, and how any shared commercial arrangement works. Hosts keep control of their own event economics unless a separate agreement says otherwise.

faq.question: Can my event be free, or ticketed?
faq.answer: Either. Hosts control their own ticketing unless a specific collaboration agreement says otherwise. There is no single central ODDfest ticket covering the distributed programme.

faq.question: What if I don't have a space yet?
faq.answer: Tell us anyway. Events can happen in venues, studios, galleries, offices and public spaces across Helsinki. We cannot promise to find you a room, but if there is a match among other hosts, venues or partners we will make the introduction — and we would rather know what you are looking for early than hear about it too late.

faq.question: What if my event is happening anyway, with or without ODDfest?
faq.answer: Then it is a good candidate. Joining the week does not change what your event is. It connects something already happening to a moment when more people are looking.

faq.question: Will anyone actually come?
faq.answer: We cannot promise you an audience, and we would not trust anyone who did. What the week does is put your event into one programme alongside everything else happening those days, and spend the week telling people the whole thing is on — so your event is not the only reason someone has to be out that night.

faq.question: When is ODDfest 2027?
faq.answer: The exact dates are not confirmed yet. Send your idea anyway — nothing is lost by being early, and we will share the dates as soon as they are set.

faq.question: Is ODDference part of ODDfest?
faq.answer: They are separate things that share a week. ODDference is ODD's own professional event, about what business and the rest of society can learn from creative expertise. It is produced centrally by ODD and has its own ticket. ODDfest is the open week made by its hosts.

faq.question: I just want to attend — how does that work?
faq.answer: Once the programme is published, every event carries its own time, place and ticketing information. You choose what you want to see across the week.

partnerCta.title: Partner with ODDfest
partnerCta.body: A week made by hundreds of people needs partners behind it — organisations that want to back the week itself, reach the people in it, or build something of their own inside it. Tell us what you have in mind and we will work out whether there is a real fit.
